messages:
Maria: Heads up — I'm lining up infra/runtime signals for the new microcost dashboard (cost per 1k tokens + cache/batch savings breakdown). Need to confirm what we can reliably emit from runtime and what infra needs to join. @Sam @Leo can you weigh in?
Sam: We should enumerate the minimal event fields first. My proposal: request_id, timestamp, model_variant, route_id, customer_id (hashed), tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit (bool), batch_size, latency_ms, instance_type, raw_cost_estimate, rollout_tag. Anything else we need?
Leo: +1 to that list. Big caveat: route_id must be low-cardinality. We can't ship full path/query params — hash or canonical route name needed. Also we should avoid customer_id plaintext — use stable hashed id.
Jin: From runtime: we can emit those fields, but two concerns: 1) high-cardinality dimensions will blow up metrics/aggregation costs; 2) emitting per-request raw_cost_estimate adds overhead to RPC path. Suggest emitting aggregated windowed stats (per-second-ish) for high-volume endpoints and deterministic sample for others.
Maria: For the dashboard accuracy we need both fine-grained (sampled) and aggregated rollups. Can we add a sampling flag on events so downstream knows to upweight?
Sam: Yes — add sample_rate (float) and is_sampled (bool). Downstream will multiply by 1/sample_rate when computing totals.
Leo: Also we need a stable join key between runtime events and infra billing messages. Suggest using request_id + ingestion_partition_ts (minute truncated) so join is deterministic.
Jin: Implementation detail: we'll expose a tiny sidecar aggregator that emits per-route minute buckets with tokens_in/out, cache_hits, batch_count, and an estimated cost using kernel-level pricing tables. That reduces per-request overhead.
Maria: Nice. For cache/batch savings breakdown the dashboard wants: gross_cost (no caching/batching), actual_cost, savings = gross_cost - actual_cost, and percent_savings. How do we define gross_cost? Model cost * tokens_out without cache or batching.
Sam: compute gross_cost based on model_vega_rate table (tokens per unit cost) — we'll need a canonical model catalog key in the event (model_key). Add model_key to schema.
Jin: We can tag events with model_key and kv_cache_hit_count (int) to estimate how much of the requested tokens were served from cache. For batching: include batch_group_id on sampled events to reconstruct actual batch sizes distribution.
Leo: Be careful: batch_group_id will increase cardinality if we store raw values. Only store batch_size distribution histograms in the rollups.
Maria: UX/rollout ask: dashboards need to show canary vs baseline delta for both cost and quality. Add rollout_tag to events so we can slice by variant.
Sam: Agree. Also add quota_bucket (enum) so we can correlate cost spikes with quota throttles.
Jin: Quick note on telemetry schema — putting here as code block for clarity:
```json
{
  "request_id": "string",
  "timestamp": "iso",
  "model_key": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "route_id": "string",
  "customer_hash": "string",
  "tokens_in": "int",
  "tokens_out": "int",
  "cache_hit": "bool",
  "kv_cache_hit_count": "int",
  "batch_size": "int",
  "batch_size_histogram": "map<int,int>",
  "latency_ms": "float",
  "sample_rate": "float",
  "is_sampled": "bool",
  "rollout_tag": "string",
  "quota_bucket": "string",
  "raw_cost_estimate": "float"
}
```
Maria: Perfect. A few policy decisions we need to confirm: 1) sampling policy (default 0.01 but 100% for customers above X spend), 2) retention of raw events (30 days sampled, 7 days unsampled rollups), 3) who owns final dashboard UX and alert thresholds.
Leo: Infra: we'll own the rollup ingestion (minute buckets) and the canonical route mapping table. We need a small API from product (or devex) to register route_id -> human name.
Sam: Eng-platform: we'll own the dashboard panels + the derived metric formulas (cost_per_1k = total_cost / (tokens_out / 1000)). We'll also wire in a per-route drilldown linking to traces.
Jin: Runtime will own instrumentation and sidecar aggregator. We'll emit both sampled raw events and minute rollups. Sampling policy: default 1% globally, 100% for requests with estimated raw_cost_estimate > $0.5 or flagged by rollout.
Maria: Action items: 
- Jin: proto for sidecar and event schema, PR by EOD Wed.
- Leo: route_id registry API + mapping kickoff, owner + doc by Fri.
- Sam: dashboard skeleton in observability workspace (panels + formulas) by next Tue.
- Maria: write brief requirements doc for product / billing to sign off on definitions (gross_cost vs actual_cost) by Thu morning.
Sam: I'll also add a lightweight eval panel that shows cost delta per rollout_tag with confidence intervals.
Leo: One more ops item: add a cardinality monitor on new dimensions (route_id, rollout_tag, model_key) and warn if unique count exceeds thresholds.
Maria: Great — thanks all. If no objections I'll create the tickets and link this thread. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-6123 "Metering telemetry schema + rollups for microcost dashboard" assigned to Jin, Sam, Leo.
